readiness.source_config_digest: Original source identity, current account digest, separately observed authorization-window digest and revision
readiness.requirements: Current independent PartnerReadiness approval, unchanged exact configuration and execution-control stamp, supported region/capability, unexpired evidence, no outage, active permissions and recovery egress

customer_consent.maximum: No more than both the approved terms maximum and the exact sum of original trial unit obligations
customer_consent.source_authorization_expiry: The native synthetic mandate records exactly confirmed_at + the independently observed account authorization_duration_ms; issuing later does not move that expiry
customer_consent.financial_execution: Consent alone creates no payment effect; existing exact ActionGateway preview, independent financial approval, receipt and original InstantExchanges dispatch are required
customer_consent.withdrawal: Revokes local and native consent for future effects; it neither reverses a committed capture nor silently waives the original obligation

delivery.authority: Immutable synthetic original-source delivery observations, scoped to trial, resource and native original order
delivery.start: No clock until the latest event confirms complete delivery; start is the maximum delivery timestamp among complete events in its correction chain
delivery.duplicate: Same event ID and digest is idempotent
delivery.correction: Strict next sequence and exact previous event reference; a correction can extend the clock but cannot shorten it
delivery.uncertain: An incomplete or null latest delivery suspends capture eligibility

source_final_guard: The original source persists the exact typed command before sending and requires the current canonical dispatcher callback before a new bound effect. Reopening the source cannot bypass this requirement. Original stored-result lookup remains available.
privacy: All five new tables are handled by canonical export, erasure and restore helpers. Customer proof/session material is omitted from export and stripped on erasure or restore. Typed additions in the original instant tables are allowlist-minimized without changing operation IDs, source IDs or unknown states.
remaining_limits: No real processor, native card data, payment network, contractual authorization duration or settlement qualification
No real delivery observation, connected warehouse or physical service qualification
Synthetic USD original-order units only; at most one hour of observed authorization duration
M07-G99, external PartnerReadiness and original M10 connected qualification remain blocked
No public release, paid transaction, production operation or automatic milestone acceptance
